expr: r1 = double(strncmp("hello", "help", 3)); r2 = double(strncmp("hello", "help", 4)); cc = strncmp({'apple','apricot','banana'}, 'app', 3); k1 = double(cc(1)); k2 = double(cc(2)); k3 = double(cc(3)); se = double(strncmp('ab','ab',5)); sne = double(strncmp('ab','abc',5));
comment: Sig: r = strncmp(s1,s2,n). DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: (a) added CELL-array support (element-wise logical array): strncmp({'apple','apricot','banana'},'app',3)=[1 0 0]; (b) fixed the short-string predicate — when both strings are shorter than n it now requires FULL equality (MATLAB): strncmp('ab','ab',5)=1, strncmp('ab','abc',5)=0 (was returning 0 whenever either was < n).
